description: Ad blocking and privacy patches for the Cinemaniac movie tracker app (it.papalillo.moviestowatch).

patches.name: Disable Advertising ID
patches.description: Replaces the Google advertising identifier (GAID) with a fixed, non-unique value and enables limit ad tracking, so requests can no longer be tied back to this device.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Stops the bundled Google Mobile Ads SDK from requesting any ad (banner, interstitial, rewarded, app open, native), so no ad is downloaded, rendered or reported.

release_notes:
First release of Cinemaniac Patches for it.papalillo.moviestowatch (5.0.7 / versionCode 172).

Patches:
- **Disable ads** (default on): neutralises all 13 load entry points of the bundled Google Mobile Ads SDK, so no ad is downloaded, rendered or reported.
- **Disable Advertising ID** (default on): replaces the Google advertising identifier (GAID) with a fixed, non-unique value and enables limit ad tracking.

The PRO tier (remove ads, custom categories, favourites, streaming providers, themes, random selection) is validated server side against api.cinemaniac.app/v1/validate/user. It is never read, written or spoofed.
